title: Machine learning-assisted directed evolution with in silico combinatorial screening
summary: A path-independent machine-learning protocol screens full combinatorial protein libraries in silico, with training-set design that avoids near-zero-fitness variants. On a four-site epistatic fitness landscape the optimized protocol reached the global fitness maximum up to 81-fold more often than single-step greedy optimization. Caveat: validation is on a combinatorial fitness landscape dataset, not a new wet-lab evolution campaign.
ai_technology: Machine-learning-assisted directed evolution (in silico combinatorial screening)

evidence.tested: The ML-assisted directed evolution protocol was compared with single-step greedy optimization on a four-site epistatic fitness landscape.
evidence.unknown: Not reported in the abstract read.
